shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml && git log -4 --oneline"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,220p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && rg \"export type ToolExecutor|type ToolExecutor|ToolDefinition\" src/types src/orchestration/tools -g '*.ts' | head -40 && cat package.json | sed -n '1,100p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts .lore/dod.md && if [ -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs ]; then node scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; fi && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,150p' && git diff --check && git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && test -f scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; echo reanchor_status="'$?'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md && git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "test: repair registry validation checks" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch && git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
